newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ SPORT-Penn, Larsen drafted into NZ team.
newsitem.headline: NZ SPORT-Penn, Larsen drafted into NZ team.

text.p: Central Districts allrounder Andrew Penn and Wellington's Gavin Larsen were on Tuesday named as additions to the New Zealand squad for the second cricket test against Sri Lanka in Hamilton.
Penn, 22, and Larsen have been brought in following injuries which have ruled out Geoff Allott and placed his fellow fast bowler Heath Davis in doubt for the match starting on Friday.

Chris Harris has been dropped from the squad after being called in on the morning of the first day of the first test in Dunedin last Friday to act as 12th man following Allott's withdrawal with a back injury.
Penn is a newcomer to the national side while veteran medium pacer Larsen has played eight tests but has not been wanted in the test arena so far this season.
Allott's immediate future remains unclear. He broke down at training last Thursday in considerable back pain and it was initially feared he had suffered a stress fracture.
He is to undergo bone scans in Christchurch this week to determine the full extent of the injury.
Davis, the Wellington fast bowler reintroduced to the test attack during last month's series against England, struggled against Sri Lanka in Dunedin with achilles tendon and knee injuries.
Team physiotherapist Mark Plummer gives Davis an 80 percent chance of being fully fit by Friday.
